mapper.select: SELECT ia.issue_id, ia.user_id, u.username, ia.assigned_at FROM issue_assignees ia INNER JOIN users u ON ia.user_id = u.id WHERE ia.issue_id = #{issueId} ORDER BY ia.assigned_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO issue_assignees (issue_id, user_id) VALUES (#{issueId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (issue_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM issue_assignees WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND user_id = #{userId}
